analysis: Round 1 found that Colorado city context raises the response at a fixed 303 contact line (86.5-126.0 versus 8.75-22.5 for matched non-Colorado cities) and that Colorado area codes 303/720/970/719 select much larger maxima than non-Colorado codes. Round 2 tests two surviving explanations: whether a genuine Colorado local entity is required rather than any occurrence of the word Colorado, and whether a Colorado area code alone is sufficient without a Colorado place name.
